verdict.rationale: Mastra is an agent framework with MCP client and server support, so whether it vets the MCP servers agents connect to is a fair question. However, the evidence never documents any scanning or inspection of listed servers for malicious or vulnerable behavior. Its guardrails act on agent inputs and outputs (prompt injection, sanitization), which is an adjacent control and earns no credit for server vetting.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on the platform scanning or inspecting listed servers for malicious or vulnerable behavior before my agents use them
